#
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**
¶2:**
 Concerning the containing
 forms:
 when the Divine
 Life
 was about to release
 these three containing
 forms, He
 caused
 them to desc
end by
 infl
ux
 into
 the natural mind, one after
 another,
 each
 at its proper stage of
 regener
ation. He released them and let
 them fall
 into
 the external
 person.


**¶3:** Then He
 drew them back out
 of the natural mind by
 means
 of three external truths — the
 tru
ths of thought, of
 rational
 knowledge
, and of pur
ified love — which had
 clothed His Divine
 presence in
 the
 natural
 degree
.
 He directed them into the three receptacles
 which
 He
 had prepared during the original
 formation of the mind's interior
 structures. Yet
 something remained upon the surface of the natural
 mind from these three
 containing forms, so that their trace
 and pattern can
 be found
 displayed
 throughout
 the whole
 of
 created
 order.

**¶4:**
 The element that
 remains within
 natural
 knowledge
 is the bitterness and harsh
ness of the
 ou
termost sens
ory knowledge — that merely
 natural knowing
, dev
oid of spiritual life
,
 which surrounds and
 encl
oses all the interior states of the mind
.

**¶5:** And
 the remnant left
 behind
 from falsity is that
 tow
ering self
-intelligence
 which
 exists at
 the very
 threshold
 where
 divine wisdom would
 first appear. For
 when divine
 wisdom rises
 to
 illuminate
 the mind, no
 light of
 wisdom
 is
 perceived
 there, because the falsity that p
ours forth from that self-intelligence manif
ests above it and obscures it entirely
.

**¶6:** And
 the remnant that
 remains behind from evil love,
 upon the natural mind, consists of all
 the
 forms of pride and all
 the isolated states of
 self
 from
 which the ex
halations of self-love rise
 up
 and become manifest. For
 these are the remnants of the great
 containing form — the vestiges of that
 self
-love which
 became
 conjoined with the evil
 love that asc
ends from the natural mind — together with
 every
 state
 of ex
alt
ation and self-elevation,
 those
 states
 where no good works can issue
 from perception,
 where
 perception
 cannot bring
 forth any fruit
 of life
 what
soever.

**¶8
:** When
 the Divine Life released these containing forms from
 the
 interior
 degrees
 into
 the natural mind, He p
oured them forth
 for this purpose
: so
 that the
 fals
ified
 tru
ths,
 the falsities, and the evil loves
 already
 dwelling
 within
 the successive
 planes
 of the natural mind would be drawn out
 and rise
 up
ward toward those which
 had descended from within
,
 and the natural planes
 of
 the mind would thereby
 be purified and cleansed.
 For
 this reason
 He permitted
 the
 containing forms of
 fals
ified
 truth,
 of
 falsity, and of evil love to
 descend into the external
 person —
 so
 that the corresponding
 falsified
 truths, falsities, and evil
 loves already
 lod
ged in the natural mind would be drawn
 forth
 toward
 what
 had descended from the
 interior.


**¶9:** First
 of
 all, He released the falsified tru
ths — the
 waste
 and
 poison
 of the dominant
 persu
asions that
 ruled
 in
 the interior mind.
 He cle
ansed the rational
 faculty
 of those
 fals
ified
 truths. He poured the
 dark
ened knowledge
 down
ward into the natural mind. Just as
 those
 falsified truths fell
 from the
 interior
 into
 the external
 person, so also the falsified tru
ths already
 existing
 below
 in the natural planes
 were
 drawn and
 rose
 up from
 beneath
 toward the falsified truths that had
 come
 down from within
.
 The tru
ths of
 the
 natural mind were purified of the pois
onous falsity that had
 dw
elt in
 them. Then
 He swept them to
 the ou
termost boundary
 and
 made them a great vessel and a wall
 of natural
 knowledge
 surrounding
 the whole
 mind
 —
 that
 ou
termost general
 knowledge upon
 which doc
trinal systems are carried
 and
 by
 which they
 navigate
.

**¶10:** After
 the falsified truths, He released
 the falsities
 themselves
. He purified the rational
 faculty and
 dried from it
 the falsity
 with which it had
 been b
urdened. He cast
 it down
 into the natural mind. Just as He
 had purified the rational faculty,
 so also He purified the natural planes
. The falsity dwelling
 in the natural mind was drawn up
ward toward the falsity that had been
 released
 from within. He swept them both out
 together
 and shut them into
 that enc
losure of falsity,
 separated
 entirely
 from living
 truth.


**¶11:** And He
 released the evil love
 from the interior
 mind into
 the natural mind.
 At
 that time, the evil love that
 had been
 confined
 within the lowest
 natural
 plane
 was drawn forth
 and rose up toward its own
 kind. Evil
 love was added to evil love.
 Afterward
, He swept it out and cast it
 into the ou
termost inf
ernal state
, which He had constructed for such
 ev
ils outside the boundaries
 of the whole
 mind
.

**¶12:** In
 the same way that He purified the
 rational faculty above as a clear
 space for divine
 tru
ths to journey and
 illuminate
, so also He purified the natural
 planes below and swept from them the evil
 love,
 the falsity, and the falsified
 truth
. He has
 purified them for the ascent of
 the
 three living
 powers — the power
 of spiritual
 thought, the power of living
 truth, and the power of genuine
 love — which ascend before the Guardian
 of
 the threshold
 and traverse all
 the planes
 of the natural
 mind in
 their return
 toward
 the Divine
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When the Father of Life discharged these three vessels from above, they of water and of darkness and of fire, did he perhaps discharge them to their pits at the edge of the firmament? Or did he discharge them first to this earth, and then he swept them from the earth and threw them to their places?

when the Father of Life was about to discharge these three vessels he poured the three upon this earth, one by one at its (appointed) hour and season. He discharged them and cast them down to the earth.

Then he bailed and scooped them from this earth in these three garments, they of wind and of water and of fire, which swathed his body. He poured and made them flow into the three pits [at the bounds of the universe, w]hich he had [es]tablished during the construc[tio]n of the worlds[. Yet] they [were not entirely purged, and] something remained behind on the face of the earth from these three vessels,
The element that is left in water is the pungency and the salinity of this salty inner sea that surrounds the worlds.

And the remnant that is left from the darkness is this black mountain that exists in the surroundings of the sunrise. For when the sun would shine over the world no sunlight is visible there, because the darkness that gushes from it manifests above it.

the vessels that surround the universe, and why they were not discharged from above into the ditches prepared for them (straightaway); but were firstly poured upon the earth, and afterwards were swept from the earth and cast down into their pits?

When the Father of Life discharged these vessels from above upon the earth, he poured them out for this reason: so that also the water and the darkness and the fire that exist in these three earths would be drawn and ascend towards they that had come down from above, and the earths would be purified and cleansed. Due to this he poured these vessels down to the earth, of water and of darkness and of fire, so that also the water and darkness and fire that exist in the earths would be drawn up towards they that had descended from above.

Now, first of all, he discharged the water, the waste, the poison of the rulers who are above. He cleansed the firmaments of the [water that burdened them, and] he poured down the dark waters. [Just as the] waters fell from heaven to earth, so also the waters below in the earths were drawn and came up from below towards the waters that had come from above to the earths. The waters [were] purified of the dark poison that exists in them. Then he swept them outside and made them a great vessel and a wall of sea that surrounds the universe, and on which the ships sail.

After the water, he discharged the darkness. He purified the firmaments and dried from them the darkness with which they are weighed down. He discharged it down to the earth. Just as he had purified the firmaments, so also he purified the earths. The darkness that is in the earths was drawn up towards the darkness that had been discharged from above. He swept them both out and shut them in that [great pit] of darkness[, which lies beyond] the water.

And he discharged the fire from heaven to earth, [and at] that time again the fire that was shut [in] the earth below was drawn and came up towards its kind. Fire was added to fire. Afterwards, he swept it out and cast it into the outer underworld, which [he had constructed for] them outside the universe.

In the same way that he purified the firmaments above as a place for the light-givers to journey [and give their light to the worlds,] so also he purified the earths below and swept from them the fire and the darkness and the water[, and cast each one into its pit.] He has purified them for the ascent of these three powers, they of the wind and the water and the fire, which ascend before the Porter and traverse the earths.

And the remnant that remains behind from the fire, upon the earth, are all the mountains and islands from where fumes of fire gush up and are visible. For these things are the remnant of the great vessel, the vestige that was conjoined with this fire that comes up from the earth; together with the mountains and hills [ ... ] places where no fruit sprouts on the trees [ ... ] greater than that place from the limb and [ ... / ... ] the trees shall not bear fruit in that place.
